resources.name: W20O58 crystal structure (Magnéli phase, space group P2/m)

access.notes: Retrieve the published W20O58 structure and then idealize it so that all WO6 octahedra are perfect with average O-O distance 2.68 Å, using the lattice parameters a=23.39 Å, b=12.1 Å, c=3.78 Å, γ=95° and space group P2/m.
